# B2B CRM — Sales Management Platform

> B2B CRM is a sales management platform for field teams and back-office operations. Manage customers, outlets, sales orders, visits, approvals, and real-time insights in one platform.

## Overview

B2B CRM is a comprehensive sales management platform designed for field sales teams, distributors, SMEs, and any organization that needs to track customer relationships, sales orders, and field activity in a structured, auditable system.

Built with React, tRPC, Prisma, and PostgreSQL — with AI-powered approval workflows, email-to-order automation, and a RAG-grounded knowledge base.

## API

- tRPC endpoint: `https://erp-sales.app/trpc`
- Full TypeScript typesafe API for all sales management operations

## Modules

### Regions & Areas
Define your sales territory with regions and sub-areas for clean reporting and access control. Group outlets into areas for territory management and regional reporting.

### Customer & Outlet CRM
Organize regions, areas, customers, and outlets in a clean hierarchy with full contact history. Manage every retail point with location, contact, and performance tracking.

### Sales Orders
Create, propose, and approve orders with a multi-level workflow and AI-assisted validation. Every document moves through a clear, multi-level workflow: Draft → AI review → Proposed → Approved or Rejected.

### Visit Logs
Track field visits with check-in, purpose, and notes — all tied to the right outlet. Field teams log visits in real-time.

### Action Programs & Events
Plan promotions and event proposals with budgets, areas, and PIC accountability. Plan and track event proposals with budgets, dates, and accountable PICs.

### Email Concierge
Inbound customer email becomes an AI-written HTML reply, sent from your company inbox — with an optional draft sales order linked to the thread. Customers email your company inbox; Email Concierge drafts an AI HTML reply, sends it from your address, and can open a draft sales order linked to the thread.

### Knowledge Base
A self-service knowledge base for your team and customers, grounded in your docs via RAG. Chat with RAG over your knowledge base.

### AI Admin
A streaming LLM assistant inside the app — grounded in your docs, wired to real tools, ready to navigate and draft. Extract orders from free-text or email, ask data in plain language → read-only SQL, auto-summarize pages & draft follow-ups.

### Users & Access
Role-based access control with granular permissions and a full activity audit trail. Every action is attributed to a specific user, and all data is stored in a PostgreSQL database with proper access controls.

## Approval Workflow

Every document (sales orders, visit logs, action programs, event proposals) goes through a multi-level approval workflow:
1. **Draft** — Document is created in draft status
2. **AI review** — LLM checks pricing, quantity & discount risk
3. **Proposed** — Document is proposed for approval
4. **Approved or Rejected** — Final decision with full audit trail

Each step is logged with timestamps and user attribution, creating a complete audit trail.

## FAQ

### What is B2B CRM?
B2B CRM is a sales management platform designed for field teams and back-office operations. It helps you manage customers, outlets, sales orders, visit logs, action programs, and approvals — all in one place with a full audit trail.

### Who is this for?
B2B CRM is built for field sales teams, distributors, SMEs, and any organization that needs to track customer relationships, sales orders, and field activity in a structured, auditable system.

### How does the approval workflow work?
Every document (sales orders, visit logs, action programs, event proposals) goes through a multi-level approval workflow: Draft → Proposed → Approved/Rejected. Each step is logged with timestamps and user attribution, creating a complete audit trail.

### Can customers place orders via email?
Yes. Email Concierge receives inbound customer email, drafts an AI HTML reply from your company inbox, and can create an optional draft sales order linked to the thread — so replies and orders stay connected without manual entry.

### Is my data secure?
Absolutely. B2B CRM uses role-based access control with granular permissions, JWT authentication, and a full activity log. Every action is attributed to a specific user, and all data is stored in a PostgreSQL database with proper access controls.

## How It Works (4 Steps)

1. **Set Up Your Sales Hierarchy** — Organize regions, areas, customers, and outlets in a clean, searchable structure.
2. **Create & Propose Orders** — Build sales orders with line items, auto-calculated totals, and AI-assisted validation.
3. **Track Field Activity** — Log visits, check-ins, action programs, and event proposals tied to the right outlet.
4. **Get Real-time Insights** — Dashboards and reports surface revenue, pipeline health, and team performance at a glance.

## Technical Stack

- Runtime: Bun + Turborepo
- Language: TypeScript (strict)
- Client: React 19 + Vite + Tauri
- Styling: Tailwind CSS v4 + shadcn
- API: tRPC v11+ (end-to-end typesafe)
- Server: Express + Prisma (PostgreSQL, ULID ids)
- Validation: Zod (@repo/schemas)
- Internationalization: react-intl (en, id)
